featured.thesis: When Treasury triples the long-end liquidity buyback the same week it sells 10s and 30s, and the 10y still clears at a multi-year high yield with strong cover, the regime is confessing that private sponsorship of duration is not enough without a standing state bid — and the market is already pricing that bid as too small. Money is in who warehouses duration (banks/pensions/HTM-SLR/dealer inventory) and the issuer as standing long-end bid while coupon supply continues — not debt scare, not Nvidia.
featured.who_collects_rent: Whoever sets captivity / balance-sheet rules and runs the buyback backstop — regulators / Treasury / Fed plumbing — not the coupon; dealers take warehouse/fees; equity of stuffed franchises can be leftover.
featured.decisive_test: (1) Sep 9 10y STAMPED — BTC 2.71, high yield 4.834%, indirects ~79% → private bid intact at high levels; buyback expansion leans cosmetic (WATCH; one auction ≠ RELEGATE). (2) TODAY Sep 10 ~$22bn 30y reopen — cover ≥ recent averages, no meaningful tail, strong indirects → private bid intact / cosmetic lean; soft cover/fat tail/weak indirects with yields elevated → sponsorship stress live. (3) TODAY first enlarged long-end buyback op — max $6bn in 10–20y (triple prior $2bn; above SB0607 ≥$4bn floor) — thick take-up into rising yields = backstop used; thin offers vs strong-sponsorship claim = plumbing overstated. (4) Nov 4 QRA — buyback maxes cut or framed temporary → structural state-bid claim fails → RELEGATE.

Nest power/interconnect under Trap #1 / AI foundation — NOT this card's headline. Calendar: Sep 15 20y; CPI Sep 11; FOMC+SEP Sep 15–16; Nov 4 refunding.
